summary: Rabbi Soffer teaches Rashi on Parashat Lech Lecha, focusing on the Berit regarding the land from the Nile to the Euphrates and the ten nations listed in the text. He covers the details of Sarai giving her maidservant Hagar to Avram after ten years in Eretz Kenaan, and examines the interactions, complaints, and pregnancy mentioned in the text. The class also explores various halakhic discussions surrounding the mitzvah of procreation.
subjects: Minhar Mitzrayim ve'ad ha'nahar ha'gadol nahar Prat
questions: What are the boundaries of the land promised in the Berit?
Why does the text list ten nations when only seven were given?
Why does the text mention that ten years had passed in Eretz Kenaan before Hagar married Avram?
How does the obligation of procreation apply regarding time and medical advancements?
What is the meaning behind Sarai's complaint to Avram about Hagar?
